The goal of this workshop series is to provide a gentle introduction to creating maps and conducting geospatial analysis without the need to have programming skills.

We have organized this curriculum into three workshops:

## Workshop 1 - I want to make a map

2-hour workshop using ArcGIS Online to create a map. This workshop will introduce the basic elements of a map and leverage ArcGIS Online to learn how to:

-   adjust the background basemap
-   add an existing data layer to a map
-   change symbology of vector data
-   draw lines and polygons on a map

The workshop ends with exporting a map suitable for inclusion in a publication.

## Workshop 2 - Exploring more geospatial data

3-hour workshop using ArcGIS Online to conduct basic GIS data exploration and visualization.

-   more about vector data
-   raster data
-   Living Atlas data
-   data import & export

## Workshop 3 - Geospatial analysis

4-hour workshop. A Carpentry-like, hands-on session introducing the 
analytical features of ArcGIS Online versus Pro on a Windows desktop.

This session will introduce the learner to the differences between Online and Pro. We will cover topics such as:

-   raster calculation
-   buffering
-   interpolation
-   zonal statistics
